DOP: 1 cora m. [ S. cora, caura], a thief, a robber; a bandit ; Abh 522 (takkaro mosako ~o); Vin I 75, 7 (ayaṃ so kārabhedako ~o); II 131, 18 (bhikkhu … vikāle aññatarena gāmadvārena atikkamati, manussā es’ ayyo ~o gacchati); III 45, 8 (kittakena kho … rājā … ~aṃ gahetvā hanati vā bandhati vā pabbājeti vā ti); 67, 10 (upaṭṭhākakulaṃ ~ehi upaddutaṃ hoti dve ca dārakā nītā honti); M I 86, 12 (te bhoge rājāno vā haranti ~ā vā haranti aggi vā ḍahati); 129, 15 (ubhatodaṇḍakena ce pi … kakacena ~ā ocarakā aṅgamaṅgāni okanteyyuṃ); II 74, 1* (~o yathā sandhimukhe gahīto); 97, 25 (~o Aṅgulimālo nāma hoti luddo lohitapāṇī hatapahate niviṭṭho adayāpanno pāṇabhūtesu); A I 47, 10 (ekacco passati ~aṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakaraṇā kārente); 68, 21 (yasmiṃ … samaye ~ā balavanto honti rājāno tasmiṃ samaye dubbalā honti); IV 223, 19 (āvudhabalā ~ā); Khp 8:2 (rājato vā duruttassa ~ato pīḷitassa vā); Ud 90, 31 (āyasmato Nāgasamālassa tena panthena gacchantassa antarāmagge ~ā nikkhamitvā hatthehi vā pādehi vā ākoṭesuṃ pattaṃ ca bhindiṃsu saṅghātiṃ ca vipphālesuṃ); Sn 135 (yo ve anarahā santo arahaṃ paṭijānati ~o sabrahmake loke); Th 724 (sutvāna ~ā isino subhāsitaṃ nikkhippa satthāni ca āvudhāni ca); Ja III 34, 6 (tasmiṃ pana kāle ~e gahetvā nimbasūle uttāsenti); V 16, 21* (~āna dhuttānaṃ gatī niketo); 100, 4* (iddhaṃ phītaṃ janapadaṃ ~ā viddhaṃsayanti taṃ); Ap 562, 7 (~aṃ vadhatthaṃ niyyantaṃ disvā); Mil 20, 14 foll. (paresaṃ bhogahārakā ~ā … gāmaghatakā ~ā … panthadūsakā ~ā); Vism 190, 22 (yattha rājāno ~e chindāpenti); Sp 54, 2 (paccantaṃ vūpasamentā ~e ghātenti); Sv 801, 18 (yathā ca aṭavito ~e ānetvā nagarassa dakkhiṇadvāre ghāteyyuṃ); Vibh-a 181, 22 (andhakāre ~assa hatthappasāraṇaṃ viya); Mhv 33:38; — corena in Ee at Ja IV 470, 23* (iṅgha āgaccha corena) is wr; Be, Ce, Se āgacchat’ orena; — ifc see ummagga- ( sv ummagga 2 ), gaṇṭhibhedaka-; — ° âbhinīta , mfn. , driven by bandits; brought low by bandits ; M I 463, 23 (na ~ā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā); S III 93, 7 (n’ eva rājābhinītā na ~ā na iṇaṭṭā; Spk II 301, 25 foll. : ye pana corehi aṭaviyaṃ gahetvā … ekacce mayaṃ sāmi tumhehi vissaṭṭhā gehaṃ anajjhāvasitvā pabbajissāma, tattha yaṃ yaṃ pupphagandhapūjādipuññaṃ karissāma tato tumhākaṃ pattiṃ dassāmā ti tehi vissaṭṭhā pabbajanti te ~ā nāma, te pi hi nāma corehi māretabbataṃ abhinītā ti ~ā nāma); Mil 32, 3 (keci ~ā pabbajanti); — °’- upaddava , °’- ūpaddava , m. , oppression by thieves or bandits; violence or insurrection by bandits ; Ja I 267, 8 (ito paṭṭhāya tumhākaṃ uppanno ~o mayhaṃ bhāro); Spk I 318, 16 (manussā ~ato paṭiviratā); — °- gāmaṇī̆ , °- gāmaṇika , m. , a thieves’ leader, a bandit chief ; Vin III 208, 7 (addasā kho °-gāmaṇiko Uppalavaṇṇaṃ bhikkhuniṃ; Sp 662, 28 : corajeṭṭhako); Th-a III 12, 20 (°-gāmaṇī); — °- geha , n. [cora + geha 1 ], a prison ; Ja VI 4, 12 (kathaṃ nu kho imamhā ~ā mucceyyan ti); Dhp-a I 193, 13 (Udenaṃ jīvagāham eva gāhāpetvā ekasmiṃ ~e pakkhipitvā dvāraṃ pidahāpetvā); — °- ghāta , m. , an executioner; a torturer ; Vin III 86, 2 (bhikkhu āghātanaṃ gantvā ~aṃ etad avoca, āvuso mā-y-imaṃ kilamesi, ekena pahārena jīvitā voropehī ti); D II 321, 23 foll. (āgamentu tāva bhavanto ~ā … vippalapantass’ eva ~ā sīsaṃ chindeyyun ti); Ja V 303, 24 (pharasuṃ ca gaṇṭhikaṃ ca gahetvā ~o idh’ eva āgacchatū ti, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se °-ghātako); Mp II 217, 13 (~assa kusalakammaṃ akusalaṃ upapīḷesi, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-ghātakassa); — °- ghātaka , m. Th-a II 22, 31 (Kosalarañño bhojakassa °-vosāpakassa putto hutvā nibbatti, Ee so; Be, Se °-vosāsakassa; Ce °-ghātakassa); — °- sādhāraṇa , mfn. , vulnerable to thieves ; A III 259, 19 (rājasādhāraṇā bhogā ~ā bhogā …); — acora , m. , one who is not a thief; not the thief ; Ja I 175, 26 (idāni pana corānaṃ kiñci bhayaṃ natthi, ~ā maraṇaṃ labhanti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee omit bhayaṃ); 385, 16 (imehi pañcahi pi ~ehi bhavitabbaṃ); Mil 186, 3 (coro niggahetabbo ~o paggahetabbo ti); Ps III 110, 20 (paṭhamavācā ~aṃ yeva coro ti … pavattā); — niccora , mfn. , free from thieves or bandits ; Ja II 422, 18´ (imaṃ nissāya no nagaraṃ ~aṃ jātan ti); Sp 195, 18 (nirabbudo ti abbudavirahito, abbudā vuccanti corā, ~o ti attho, corā ti ca imasmiṃ atthe dussīlā adhippetā); Sv 922, 6 (akhilaṃ animittaṃ akaṇṭakan ti ~aṃ); — sacora , mfn. , infested with bandits ; Vism 647, 28 (savisaṃ viya bhojanaṃ ~o viya maggo); — see also acorāharaṇa.

DOP: corī f. [ S. caurī], a female thief or robber ; Vin IV 226, 8 (kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo ~iṃ pabbājessantī ti); V 56, 5 (~iṃ vuṭṭhāpentiyā saṅghādiseso); A IV 92, 21* (~ī ca bhariyā ti ca sā pavuccati); Ja I 295, 7* (~īnaṃ bahu-buddhīnaṃ yāsu saccaṃ sudullabhaṃ thīnaṃ bhāvo durājāno); II 363, 15* (kāyaṃ balākā sikhinī ~ī; 363, 20´ : kulassa ananuññāya kulagharaṃ kākassa vā aruciyā kākapacchiṃ paviṭṭhattā ~ī ti vadati); V 448, 29* (~iyo kaṭhinā h’ etā; 449, 27´ : sambhatassa dhanassa vināsanena ~iyo); Kkh 2 288, 17 (coritā corisaññitā …); — corim eva in Ee at Ps III 110, 22 is wr for coraṃ yeva ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- vuṭṭhāpana , n. , ordaining a (female) thief ; Vin V 89, 33 (jāyati tīhi dvārehi ~aṃ idaṃ); Sp 948, 9 (~aṃ gāmantaraṃ ārāmasikkhāpadaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce corī-uṭṭhāpanaṃ; Ee corī uṭṭhānaṃ); Utt-vn 192; 338; — °- vuṭṭhāpikā , f. , one who ordains a thief ; Utt-vn 182 (~ā cāpi ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ phuse); — acorī , f. , one who is not a thief ; Vin IV 227, 14 (~iyā corīsaññā); Kkh 2 288, 14 ; Mp III 248, 17 (athenī ti atheniyo ~iyo).
